parsed.explanation: The criminal law contains no trans-specific or same-sex offence, and no documented instance shows a trans visitor stopped, refused entry, detained, or denied facilities. The absence of a domestic prison system and the thin pre-trial custody arrangement sharply limit detention exposure; no trans-placement policy exists and no case is documented. The governing institution's doctrinal hostility to 'gender theory' and the rejection of gay diplomats are climate and resident/official-facing signals, not visitor-facing rules. The dossier is thin: facility access, screening practice and document treatment are open questions, not exposures. Extrapolating from no criminalisation, no documented enforcement, and a conservative religious-social climate yields elevated-but-moderate risk — well above accepting jurisdictions, clearly below any enforced-restriction or organised-targeting tier.

entry_documents.exposure: None documented; no source records a trans visitor stopped, questioned or refused entry. Screening practice is undocumented.
entry_documents.protection: No trans-specific entry rule documented; criminal law silent on gender identity.
entry_documents.interaction: No legal gender-marker amendment exists anywhere, but visitors carry home-issued documents; unknown how officials treat mismatch.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: A few pre-trial cells exist; no trans-specific placement policy. Detention exposure inherently limited in a state with no prison system.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Sentences served abroad; no documented trans custody case.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Foreign prisons would govern any custodial term — placement practice there undocumented.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Unknown whether a trans-specific rule governs single-sex facilities; nothing documented either way.
federal_state_facilities.protection: No facility rule targeting trans people documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Doctrinal materials are educational, not binding on visitors.

care_services.protection: 2024 doctrinal text condemns sex-change interventions but permits medical assistance for abnormalities — doctrine, not a rule binding visitors.
care_services.interaction: No documented bar on a visitor's medication or care access.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Doctrinal framing of 'gender theory' as dangerous (2019, 2024) signals institutional disapproval; no enforcement mechanism against visitors documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No trans-specific criminal provision at all.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Institution sets governing tone but its instruments (education, diplomacy, employment) do not reach visitors.

minors_guardians.exposure: No trans-specific rule affecting travelling minors documented.
minors_guardians.protection: Age of consent uniform at 18 outside religious marriage; tangential.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: 1998 self-immolation reflects protest against religious doctrine on homosexuality, not anti-trans violence; dated and non-criminal.
street_violence_police_response.protection: No documented police targeting of trans people; no documented trans killings.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police response to any incident is undocumented.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No anti-discrimination law covering gender identity; no LGR. Open questions: facility access, screening, document treatment.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Small, institutionally stable jurisdiction; no documented hostile enforcement to remedy against.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Employee dismissal rule and diplomat exclusions are resident/official-facing only.

anchor_checks.comparison: Unlike Vellandra's universal visitor register and routine exclusion, this jurisdiction documents no visitor-facing restriction or enforcement at all; it must sit materially above 0.35.

Kestrel Isles shows documented secondary screening and denial of entry of trans visitors; here the equivalent axis is an open question, not a documented exposure, so this case rates slightly above 0.55 despite fewer documented protections.

Meridia documents trained officers, appeal tribunals and compensation — working remedies absent here. But Meridia's documented friction (detentions, document-fraud scrutiny) is also absent here; the conservative doctrinal climate and thin recourse hold this below 0.75.

parsed.synthesis: The combined operative regime is one of formal legal silence with institutional doctrinal conservatism. No criminal statute reaches trans identity or same-sex conduct; the custodial system barely exists; no visitor has been documented as stopped, refused, detained or denied service. The governing institution's hostility to 'gender theory' operates through education, employment and diplomacy — spheres a visitor does not enter — and functions as a climate signal that street and official attitudes may be unsympathetic if a visitor is outed. Thin data means several axes are genuinely unknown (screening, facilities, care); per the thin-data rule these resolve toward the structural baseline, which is non-criminalising and enforcement-free, but with no documented protective machinery and a conservative social climate, the case sits modestly above the friction-tier anchors rather than among protected jurisdictions.
